metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:protocol: Versioned rules printed before effects; only diagnostic corruption pools use training transition counts. No auxiliary recommendation scores or model fitting.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:coverage: Actual users, unique prefixes, plans and failures. Failed matching removes the entire four-plan block; absence is not zero effect. Doses can have different support.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:architecture: Possible offsets include causal-summary gates when supplied implementation is recognized. Unknown architecture disables structural interpretation. Masks may reduce possible reachability. Structural reachability is not learned influence; exact path counts unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:chunked_rank_synthetic_che: Chunked score/rank tie counter verified against exhaustive synthetic sorting at several chunk sizes.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:identity_controls: Repeated identical-input catalog score discrepancy and target-rank change; expected zero within numerical precision. Causality, all-padding and applicable unreachable checks are in architecture. These local controls do not prove calibration or CI coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:matching_failures: Auditable user/cut/dose/draw failures and pool sizes. A failed greedy assignment is an algorithmic failure, not proof that no valid assignment exists. No tolerance is relaxed; effects condition on successful assignments.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampler_designs: Per-prefix deterministic sampler seed, actual module-source hashes, support and recognition status. Recognized supplied sampler is uniform without replacement on IDs outside the complete training history. Prefix inputs still contain only earlier interactions. Each 64-negative diagnostic draw has pi=min(64,N)/N on its actual support and zero elsewhere; no eligibility renormalization. First min(training_negative_count,N) entries reproduce the training accepted-set distribution when its count is at most 64. Unrecognized implementations receive diagnostic-only sampling claims. Hashes identify inspected sources, not a proof for arbitrary modified implementations.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:historical_negative_exposu: Unavailable without actual training context-negative logs; post-training diagnostic draws cannot reconstruct historical exposure or contemporaneous gradients.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:gradient_reference_compari: Optional autograd comparison omitted under the fixed probe-work cap. Reported objective logit derivatives are analytical per-position derivatives, not parameter-gradient alignment, logical-batch gradients or historical optimizer contributions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:outranker_transitions: Raw successful plan counts by variant for zero-to-zero, zero-to-positive, positive-to-zero and positive-to-positive strict-outranker transitions. Missing keys mean no observed transition of that type. Rank/count differences retain zero-outranker cases; coverage differences require nonempty outranker sets in both contexts.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:audit_support: Eligible and retained distinct prefixes/users per variant plus history-length and training-target-frequency counts. Retained strata deduplicate prefixes across corruption draws; eligible strata count all clean prefixes. Effects condition on successful complete cases and metric-specific observed_users in intervention_effects; no population weighting is applied.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:competitor_audit: Stored in baseline and paired observations. E excludes target/PAD and freezes original-full-prefix eligibility; restricted contexts remove the same inserted IDs. H uses strict score outranking; ties and lower-ID ties are separate. C_count is unique sampled H coverage; C0 is its exact design expectation; their ratio is null for empty H or zero C0. C_soft is unique sampled exp-score mass divided by eligible-negative mass. p_target uses target plus E; A=(1-p_target)*C_soft; M=p_target+A. Empty sampled sets have zero captured mass; empty E makes C_soft undefined. Stable logsumexp uses raw temperature-one logits. 2*(1-M) is the full-versus-unique-subset softmax logit-gradient L1 identity only, without sampling corrections, multiplicity weighting or batch coefficients. Analytical negative and positive gradients use the recognized actual objective and its training draw count, before supervised-position batch averaging/clipping; restricted losses are diagnostic extensions. Repetition records preserve accepted IDs, retained unique IDs, multiplicities, exclusions and denominators. Paired sampler SE and quantiles describe shared-draw differences conditional on each fixed corruption, separate from the corruption_mc_se and user-bootstrap intervals. Inner draws are averaged before prefix/user aggregation and never count as users. Context-independent coverage baselines measure accessibility, not optimization quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean pairwise item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero; alignment alone cannot establish collapse or recommendation quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over valid aligned training-loader positions; in-sample sampled separation only.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of valid training-loader margins; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training positions where negative score exceeds positive score.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training positions with margin below protocol eps.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Low/wrong-margin counts; category lists empty because item categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_prefix_hr10_user_: Training-target exact eligible-catalog HR@10 averaged within user then across users; not host validation or generalization.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:intervention_effects: Changed-minus-clean ranks, HR@10, target score and fixed-negative mean margin; positive delta_rank is worse. Overlap is top-10 intersection/original top-10 size. Draws average within prefix, prefixes within user, then users equally. CI95 is exploratory percentile bootstrap of user means, null below two users. corruption_mc_se separately propagates within-prefix draw variance, conditional on successful matching and treating prefix draws as independent; null when any contributing prefix has fewer than two observations. More draws do not add independent users. recent_minus_older is a paired difference on the same successful four-plan blocks, with the same restricted catalog; never assume monotonic dose response.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:strata: Fixed prefix, training-frequency, repeated-target, transition, reachability and displacement strata. Displacement bins are [0,.5), [.5,1), [1,infinity); displacement is measured, not matched. Compare bands only where both have support; intervals are exploratory without multiplicity or coverage guarantees.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:baseline_observations: Clean exact ranks with fixed original full-prefix eligibility, target retained once even when repeated; catalog size and margin-negative count are denominators.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:paired_observations: In-place replacements preserve occupancy, padding, terminal item, sequence length and timestamp positions. Fixed catalogs include inserted candidates. Restricted catalogs remove the same union of inserted IDs from all paired histories and both bands/types; they are not full-catalog ranks. Inserted score/rank gains refer to the fixed eligible catalog. Frequency bins and possible reachability match across bands; path counts and displacement do not. Permutations separately preserve the original item multiset. Neither score changes nor restricted-rank decomposition identify causal user intent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:four_category_macro: Unavailable in a single-category call; never substitute a pooled-user or single-category value. The pinned host macro validation HR@10 alone selects model trials.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:category_breakdown: No item-category metadata is available; dataset routes remain unchanged.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable: Explicit unobserved data or unmeasured quantities; missing evidence must not be invented.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:diagnostic_cost: Synchronized wall time includes CPU work and all probes. GPU compute time is not separately measured; host search-budget accounting remains authoritative.

metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean pairwise item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero; alignment alone cannot establish collapse or recommendation quality.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over valid aligned training-loader positions; in-sample sampled separation only.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of valid training-loader margins; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training positions where negative score exceeds positive score.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training positions with margin below protocol eps.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Low/wrong-margin counts; category lists empty because item categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:training_prefix_hr10_user_: Training-target exact eligible-catalog HR@10 averaged within user then across users; not host validation or generalization.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:intervention_effects: Changed-minus-clean ranks, HR@10, target score and fixed-negative mean margin; positive delta_rank is worse. Overlap is top-10 intersection/original top-10 size. Draws average within prefix, prefixes within user, then users equally. CI95 is exploratory percentile bootstrap of user means, null below two users. corruption_mc_se separately propagates within-prefix draw variance, conditional on successful matching and treating prefix draws as independent; null when any contributing prefix has fewer than two observations. More draws do not add independent users. recent_minus_older is a paired difference on the same successful four-plan blocks, with the same restricted catalog; never assume monotonic dose response.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:strata: Fixed prefix, training-frequency, repeated-target, transition, reachability and displacement strata. Displacement bins are [0,.5), [.5,1), [1,infinity); displacement is measured, not matched. Compare bands only where both have support; intervals are exploratory without multiplicity or coverage guarantees.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:baseline_observations: Clean exact ranks with fixed original full-prefix eligibility, target retained once even when repeated; catalog size and margin-negative count are denominators.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:paired_observations: In-place replacements preserve occupancy, padding, terminal item, sequence length and timestamp positions. Fixed catalogs include inserted candidates. Restricted catalogs remove the same union of inserted IDs from all paired histories and both bands/types; they are not full-catalog ranks. Inserted score/rank gains refer to the fixed eligible catalog. Frequency bins and possible reachability match across bands; path counts and displacement do not. Permutations separately preserve the original item multiset. Neither score changes nor restricted-rank decomposition identify causal user intent.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:four_category_macro: Unavailable in a single-category call; never substitute a pooled-user or single-category value. The pinned host macro validation HR@10 alone selects model trials.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:category_breakdown: No item-category metadata is available; dataset routes remain unchanged.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:unavailable: Explicit unobserved data or unmeasured quantities; missing evidence must not be invented.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:diagnostic_cost: Synchronized wall time includes CPU work and all probes. GPU compute time is not separately measured; host search-budget accounting remains authoritative.

compaction.policy: preserve top-level metric names; cap nested raw examples, never fabricate measurements
